title: Show a contact for every customer
prompt: For every customer, return first_name and contact. contact is the customer's email, or the text no email when the email is missing. An email that is empty text is a real value and must be shown as it is.
hints: Every customer must appear, so this is not a job for WHERE.
Which function returns its first value unless that value is NULL?

wrongAnswers.misconception: Drops the customers with no email instead of labeling them.
Treats empty text as a missing value.

feedback: Check two things: every customer appears, and only a missing email becomes no email.
